cpuDefinition: Sum of cumulative user+kernel CPU-time deltas for all processes in this isolated Chrome instance divided by wall time; 100% = one occupied logical core. Machine-capacity percentage divides by logical core count.
gpuDefinition: Device-wide Apple GPU driver PerformanceStatistics via IORegistry, sampled approximately once per second. Includes all applications; idle deltas are contextual observations, not per-process attribution. Driver counter averaging window is undocumented.
measurement: Raw parser + full redraw with scheduler disabled, warmed 32 frames. Fixed-rate modes yield every update; unlimited mode yields every 8 and GPU-fences every 32. These are logical updates, not display FPS. Ghostty uses the main-thread core without SDK worker/IPC.
